title: Dashboard
subtitle: Overview of revenue, payments, and profit.
totalRevenueDesc: Value of all invoices for the selected period
totalSalesReturnDesc: Value of returns recorded for the selected period
totalDiscountDesc: Discounts granted on invoices for the selected period
